items.label: H.Amdt. 29
items.purpose: Pursuant to the provisions of H. Res. 458, the amendment in the nature of a substitute recommended by the Committee on Small Business now printed in the bill is considered as adopted.

dimensions.assessment: Affects all individual applicants and business owners seeking SBA 7(a) or 504 loans who must verify their citizenship status.
dimensions.evidence: The Administrator of the Small Business Administration shall ensure that any application for a loan submitted under section 7(a)... or title V... includes the following information

dimensions.assessment: Excludes certain visa holders, asylees, refugees, and nonimmigrants from eligibility for these loan programs.
dimensions.evidence: An applicant for a loan... is ineligible for such loan if... any direct or indirect owner of such applicant concern is an ineligible person

dimensions.assessment: Restricts loan access based on status, but specific economic or budget totals are not provided.
Amends application and eligibility rules for two major SBA loan programs.
dimensions.evidence: To require the Administrator of the Small Business Administration to require an applicant for certain loans... to provide certain citizenship status documentation

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent application requirements for future loan applicants.
dimensions.evidence: in the case such applicant submits the application for such loan after the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: Data on how many loan applicants will be disqualified by the new restrictions.
Administrative costs of verifying the new documentation.
importance_detail.rationale: Imposes strict citizenship and lawful residency certification requirements on applicants for specific Small Business Administration loan programs.

related.label: H.Res. 458
related.title: Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 2483) to reauthorize certain programs that provide for opioid use disorder prevention, treatment, and recovery, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 2931) to direct the Administrator of the Small Business Administration to relocate certain offices of the Small Business Administration in sanctuary jurisdictions, and for other purposes; providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 2966) to require the Administrator of the Small Business Administration to require an applicant for certain loans of the Administration to provide certain citizenship status documentation, and for other purposes; and providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 2987) to amend the Small Business Act to require a limit on the number of small business lending companies, and for other purposes.
